results.title: Call for Main Conference Papers - EMNLP 2026
results.content:
EMNLP 2026 invites the submission of long and short papers featuring substantial, original, and unpublished research on empirical methods for Natural Language Processing.
Main Conference (dates for Workshops/Tutorials TBD) — October 24 - 29, 2026
Authors commit their reviewed articles to a publication venue (e.g., EMNLP 2026), where Senior Area Chairs and Program Chairs make acceptance decisions from the ARR reviews and meta-reviews.

results.title: Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP) 2025 - Apple Machine Learning Research
results.content:
Apple is presenting new work at the annual Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP) conference, which takes place in person from November 4 - 9, in Suzhou, China.
Richard Bai is a Workshop Co-Organizer for Widening Natural Language Processing (WiNLP).
Maureen de Seyssel is a Workshop Reviewer for Tailoring AI: Exploring Active and Passive LLM Personalization (PALS).
